scenes.title: Surprise from Voronezh
scenes.summary: Max prepares a romantic surprise for Vika, only for his half-brother Denis, a pianist from Voronezh, to arrive at the door.

scenes.title: Creative Differences
scenes.summary: Denis plays the piano and recalls how his boss's wife in Voronezh tried to blackmail him into an affair before her husband walked in.

scenes.title: The Half-Brother
scenes.summary: Denis explains that he wants a break from music and asks to stay with Max and Vika while he looks for an apartment.

scenes.title: Morning Trip to the Store
scenes.summary: Vika wakes up hoping Denis has gone back to Voronezh, only for Denis to return from the grocery store covered in mud after pushing a car.

scenes.title: Connections at the Restaurant
scenes.summary: Max promises Vika that she can hire Denis as a waiter at Claude Monet so he can move out, while Nagiyev calls a friend to find a new head chef.

scenes.title: The Sous-Chef's Orders
scenes.summary: Lyova tries to keep discipline in the kitchen after Viktor's firing, Viktor shows up pretending all is forgiven, and Nagiyev orders him out.

scenes.title: Barinov's Pride
scenes.summary: When the cooks tell Viktor that his own bad temper got him fired, Viktor insults them all and storms out, boasting that any restaurant will take him.

scenes.title: First Day as a Waiter
scenes.summary: Max encourages Denis on his first shift as a waiter while Viktor gets rejected at upscale restaurants and Denis accidentally hurts Vika's finger.

scenes.title: A Second Chance for Nagiyev
scenes.summary: Lyova notices Max is missing from the kitchen while Nagiyev hosts film producer Ruben Grigoryevich in the dining room and Viktor walks in as a guest.

scenes.title: A Guest at the Table
scenes.summary: Viktor insists on dining at Claude Monet as a customer, Nagiyev tells Denis to serve him without making a scene, and Viktor orders the chef's special.

scenes.title: The Chef's Special
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya prepare a mocking prank dish for Viktor while Max returns with Vika from the clinic and Denis carries the plate out to Viktor.

scenes.title: Scandal in the Dining Room
scenes.summary: Viktor erupts when he sees the prank dish, Nagiyev has security throw him out and fires Denis on the spot, and Elena offers Viktor a job.

scenes.title: No Need for the Construction Site
scenes.summary: Senya and Lyova discuss Viktor's meltdown while Max stops Denis from taking a construction job and decides to bring him into the kitchen.

scenes.title: A Newcomer on Prep
scenes.summary: Max apologizes to Lyova for falling behind and persuades him to take Denis on a trial period as a kitchen prep cook.

scenes.title: The Kitchen as an Orchestra
scenes.summary: Lyova urges Viktor to make peace with Nagiyev, Max shows Denis how to chop vegetables like a musician, and Viktor returns sober to apologize.

scenes.title: Apology Rejected
scenes.summary: Viktor apologizes to Nagiyev and asks to come back, but Nagiyev rejects his apology and lectures him for treating his boss like a drinking buddy.

scenes.title: The Black Ledger and the Fire
scenes.summary: Viktor tries to blackmail Nagiyev with his secret accounting ledger, Nagiyev burns it, and in the kitchen Lyova fires Denis after a grill fire.

scenes.title: Spartak Fans and a Twist of Fate
scenes.summary: Denis bonds with the accountant and with Viktor over Spartak Moscow, Viktor asks Lyova to rehire Denis, and Viktor accidentally hits Nagiyev with his car.
